author: The Current
description:
Duluth singer-songwriter Sophie Hiroko and her band bring their brand of rock to a live taping of the Local Show on The Current
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

As part of Minnesota Music Month, Duluth singer-songwriter Sophie Hiroko and her band participated in a live taping of The Local Show recorded in the Forum at Minnesota Public Radio. Together with Bunny Blood, Sophie Hiroko topped the Minnesota Music Month Scouting Report, based on a poll of 245 people, including people who work in arts journalism, venues, promotion, music retail, artist representation, music manufacturing, and more. 

“What a whirlwind, truly,” Hiroko says. “Dreams coming true before my eyes, feeling like this is exactly where I'm supposed to be right now, and I've never felt that before. Feeling the depths of gratitude in a way that I've never felt before.”

Watch the full session and interview above.
